scientific_hypothesis: The parent's Hungarian correspondence is purely geometric (assignment_element_cost=0.0), so matched generated atoms can be assigned to teacher ligand points of a different element. Raising the detached correspondence cost to 0.5 should bias the local assignment toward element-consistent matches, changing which generated atoms receive the pointwise pseudo-Huber pull and thereby the local displacement field. This is a conditional correspondence hypothesis, not a claim that element identity is a hydrogen-bond role or that any element channel carries interaction energy.
